name: Veredram Sprite
text: You're more obviously dangerous than most sprites, with a body that looks like a mass of thorny vines. You gain a prickly vine unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your prickly vine is in the brawling group and has the finesse and unarmed traits. You can apply injury poisons to your prickly vine as though it were a weapon without risk of poisoning yourself.
